reviewScope: Internal engineering, model-consistency and browser-viewport review; not independent expert certification, official board alignment, physical-device/FPS/printer or real water-treatment validation. Already prepared ideal primary/floc references; no coagulant dose or aggregation kinetics. Equivalent impermeable spherical Stokes envelope with chosen Df2, uniform dilute suspension and fixed bed packing. No calibrated permeability, irregular-shape drag, turbulence, collisions, fragmentation, diffusion, dissolution or chemical treatment. Clear appearance does not establish purity. Microscopic cores/representative packets are explanatory structures, not measured morphology or literal particle inventory. Editorial class placement with numerical teacher extensions.
